text: 国际货币基金组织(IMF)驻华首席代表马歇尔·米尔斯近日称，中国服务消费一直在强劲增长，IMF相信该领域仍有相当大的扩展空间，这也是随着经济体收入水平提高而出现的一种预期趋势。 米尔斯表示，IMF乐见中国政府将政策重点放在扩大内需上，尤其是消费和服务消费。 米尔斯认为，从经济总量看，中国服务业规模占比及服务消费水平增长潜力可观。未来，应加快推进已出台的服务业支持措施，包括降低服务业壁垒、建设全国统一大市场、营造公平竞争环境，这将释放新需求，而数字化与人工智能也有望进一步提升服务业生产率。（中新网）
text_en: Marshall Mills, IMF Chief Representative to China, recently stated that China's services consumption has been growing strongly, and the IMF believes there remains considerable room for expansion in this area, an expected trend as economies' income levels rise. Mills said the IMF welcomes the Chinese government's policy focus on expanding domestic demand, especially consumption and services consumption. He believes that from an overall economic perspective, China's services sector share and services consumption growth potential are substantial. Going forward, implementation of existing services support measures should be accelerated, including lowering services sector barriers, building a unified national market, and fostering a fair competition environment, which will unlock new demand, while digitalization and artificial intelligence are also expected to further boost services sector productivity. (Chinanews.com)
